def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    if not customers:
        return []
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    nn = instance.get("nearest_neighbors", {})
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", 0) or 0
    descriptors = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}

    cust_set = set(customers)

    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for v in r:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def best_feasible_insertion(routes, r_idx, node):
        r = routes[r_idx]
        load = route_load(r)
        if load + demands[node] > capacity:
            return None
        best_pos = None
        best_delta = None
        # insert node into r at position pos (before pos element)
        m = len(r)
        prev = depot
        for pos in range(m + 1):
            if pos == 0:
                nxt = r[0] if m > 0 else depot
                new_edge = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][nxt]
                old_edge = matrix[depot][nxt] if m > 0 else 0
            elif pos == m:
                prev = r[m - 1]
                nxt = depot
                new_edge = matrix[prev][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                old_edge = matrix[prev][depot]
            else:
                a = r[pos - 1]
                b = r[pos]
                new_edge = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b]
                old_edge = matrix[a][b]
            delta = new_edge - old_edge
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and (pos < best_pos)):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos
        return best_pos, best_delta

    # --- Small, targeted evolution of incumbent: prefer deterministic Clarke-Wright savings when it helps ---
    # We keep incumbent as a safe fallback if merges don't yield full coverage.
    customers_sorted = sorted(customers)
    # Determine if instance seems "bottleneck/trap" like, where savings typically helps.
    bottleneck_like = False

        family = descriptors.get("structure", "") or descriptors.get("family", "") or ""
        trap = descriptors.get("trap", 0)
        corridor = descriptors.get("corridor", 0)
        clusteredness = descriptors.get("clusteredness", 0)
        demand_pressure = descriptors.get("demand pressure", descriptors.get("demand_pressure", 0))

    elif bottleneck_like and n > 120:

    descriptors = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}

        s = 0
        for v in r:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        return c

            return None

        best_delta = None

        m = len(r)
        prev = depot
        for pos in range(m + 1):

                nxt = r[0] if m > 0 else depot
                new_edge = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][nxt]
                old_edge = matrix[depot][nxt] if m > 0 else 0
            elif pos == m:
                prev = r[m - 1]
                nxt = depot
                new_edge = matrix[prev][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                old_edge = matrix[prev][depot]
            else:
                a = r[pos - 1]
                b = r[pos]
                new_edge = matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b]
                old_edge = matrix[a][b]
            delta = new_edge - old_edge
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and (pos < best_pos)):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos
        return best_pos, best_delta

    bottleneck_like = False

        family = descriptors.get("structure", "") or descriptors.get("family", "") or ""
        trap = descriptors.get("trap", 0)
        corridor = descriptors.get("corridor", 0)
        clusteredness = descriptors.get("clusteredness", 0)
        demand_pressure = descriptors.get("demand pressure", descriptors.get("demand_pressure", 0))
        # heuristic conditions: two_cluster_bottleneck or very high corridor/trap
        if "bottleneck" in str(family) or (trap is not None and trap > 0.06) or (corridor is not None and corridor > 0.08):
            bottleneck_like = True
        if demand_pressure is not None and demand_pressure > 0.97 and clusteredness is not None and clusteredness > 0.9:
            bottleneck_like = True
    else:
        bottleneck_like = True

    # Savings construction
    # Only compute savings for limited neighborhood pairs if large instance to keep runtime bounded.
